d: On February 21, 1944, returning from a massive mission over Germany, two American B17 Flying Fortress bombers collided in mid-air just minutes from the safety of their base. All 21 crew members perished as the aircraft plummeted into the Norfolk marshes. Decades later, historians and archaeologists embark on a high-stakes three-day excavation to unearth the wreckage, retrieve lost artifacts, and piece together the tragic final moments of these brave airmen. Discover how a single feathered propeller unlocks the true cause behind one of the most heartbreaking aviation disasters of WW2.
